svg.text: A · Plaza shop row, seen from the square (front view)
Shops are lower (4.5 m ground floor) with 3 floors of flats on top, joined all the way along. A walk-through passage only after every 2 shops.
Each shop gets its own logo on the sign band, an awning in its colour, outside tables, and glass you can see through. Grand Groceries is double width with a supermarket front (trolleys, posters).
B · Car park between the Plaza and Cluster 1 (from above)
Rows: 1 row · aisle · 2 rows back to back · aisle · 1 row, every row under solar roofs. Almost no gap to the houses: just a kerb and a little buggy lane.
The path next to the domes turns into a red walking track. The other one becomes a two-way buggy road with a dashed middle line. Between them: a thinner, slightly raised kerb strip.
